name: solera
description: Solera — a slim harness that splits WorkItems as deep as their results need, records gate, children, or person acceptance per item, and orders the work an external AI agent executes. It supervises rather than builds, and works standalone over a plain-file .noory/solera/ workspace, with or without mashbill. Ships skills (plan / run / decide / retro / feedback) and SessionStart/Stop hooks over a `solera` CLI.
